explanation: The package-first TypeScript workflow with riffdb new and riffdb dev --seed --run made building the Orders and Inventory HTTP web application straightforward with zero handwritten transport or codec glue. Generated TypeScript bindings provided end-to-end type safety, exact decimal support, and built-in read-after-commit helpers for OrderDetail, CustomerHistory, OpenOrders, and InventoryDashboard. One diagnostic on money fields in MCP tool generation lacked a structured code, so switching product and line prices to fixed-scale decimal resolved compilation cleanly.
